1.11 Limits

  • Disk mode: names must be UTF-8 and valid for exFAT, and timestamps must fall between 1980 and 2107. The case-folding table covers ASCII letters only. Unsupported names and times fail; they are not rewritten.
  • Previews plugin: classic TIFF only (not BigTIFF), files under 4 GiB. A preview is added, never replaced. JPEGs that already contain EXIF are served unchanged. A metadata DNG’s XMP is served as it is, so its dc:format still says image/dng.
  • One session at a time through the launcher.
  • A stable source: files changed while served fail to read; restart after intended changes. A plugin’s prepared state, such as the PMP history snapshot or the previews map, is fixed for the session.
  • Writable views are per session. Written bytes are discarded on stop; only what a plugin saves is kept.
  • NFS mode is experimental.
  • Local use only. There is no TLS, no user authentication and no sharing across a network; the HTTP URL is a localhost capability.
